messages:
jamal_oncall: monitor-bot flagged a huge spike to /api/v1/generate — ~18k RPS from same ASN, error rate up ~5%. seeing this since 09:12 UTC

monitor-bot: [ALERT] Traffic anomaly detected: 18,200 RPS to /api/v1/generate from 3 CIDRs. threshold exceeded. alert id: alert-2024-04-15-0912

maria_sec: on it. immediate steps: 1) challenge suspect traffic via WAF 2) apply per-ip and per-key rate limits 3) collect pcaps for 10m. who can push rules?

alex_platform: i can push. rolling a WAF challenge now. will also add rate-limit rule grouped by api_key+ip. eta ~60s

jamal_oncall: please also apply a short-term global token bucket on the route: 50 rps per token per minute, burst 100. prioritize tokens from enterprise customers.

alex_platform: applied WAF rule RU-2024-04-15-01 -> action: challenge + js challenge for suspicious UA. added rate-limit RL-2024-04-15 grouping by api_key and ip. sample config in case folks need to copy:```
 id: RL-2024-04-15
 match: path starts_with /api/v1/generate
 limit: requests_per_minute: 3000, group_by: [api_key, ip]
```

maria_sec: pushing blocklist for top offending ASN ranges to WAF and firewall. starting pcap capture now, saving to s3://redwood-incidents/ddos/1742003456.pcap (10m window)

olivia_custsuc: heads up — EU customers might see 5-10% higher latency. want me to send a short notice?

jamal_oncall: yes please. suggested: "We're mitigating elevated traffic against our inference endpoints; you may see delays for some requests. We're working on it and will update in 30m." keep it generic.

olivia_custsuc: sent to affected customers at 09:35 UTC and cc'd legal.

maria_sec: post-incident actions: create ticket for these items — 1) automated reroute to spare region on traffic surge, 2) tighten default per-token and per-ip rate limits, 3) scheduled WAF rule review and runbook update. i'll open the ticket after this.

sre: agree. update runbook to 'challenge then rate-limit' sequence and add thresholds. also ensure audit logs for the mitigation are stored and encrypted. confirm KMS key usage.

alex_platform: logs and capture uploaded. logs forwarded to audit bucket. KMS key in use: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/key-ops-01

monitor-bot: Incident status: traffic normalized to baseline at 09:52 UTC. duration ~40m. peak 18.2k RPS -> baseline ~1.2k RPS.

jamal_oncall: closing thread. ticket TICKET-4521 created with action items and owners. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
